scope: Focused private Qt Quick probe of the current DomainOSPopupToggle state machine used by the Applications menu and pinned-applications drawer.

method.environment: Qt6 QQuickView with offscreen/software backend; the exact current DomainOSPopupToggle.qml was copied byte-for-byte into a disposable fixture under ~/tempia.
method.inputs: Synthetic anchor Items emitted the same pointerPressed/pointerCancelled signals consumed by DomainOSPopupToggle. Each of the menu and drawer helper instances was exercised through open, same-anchor close, next-click reopen, popup-first dismissal on the same event, deferred latch clear, and following-click reopen.
method.source_integration: Static inspection confirms PanelButton emits pointerPressed on MouseArea press; DomainOSPanel routes the Applications launcher action to DomainOSRuntime; DomainOSApplications.showMenu() and showDrawer() both call their respective DomainOSPopupToggle instances.
method.discarded_attempt: The first harness draft placed multiple clicks inside one Qt event dispatch and was invalid; only the corrected asynchronous run below is evidence.

limits: This verifies the helper state machine with the same signal names and the current source file; it does not inject a physical pointer into the production plasmashell panel.
It does not replace live review of both menus on the user desktop or human acceptance.
conclusion: Both production helper instances’ state-machine paths pass in the corrected private fixture, including same-button close/reopen and native-popup-first dismissal. No production change was indicated. P01 remains open for the live desktop review.
next: Continue only P01. Ask for/await the user’s live menu review; do not claim full desktop acceptance from this helper fixture.
